scheme_name: Centre of Excellence for Drones & Counter Drone Systems
overview: The Centre of Excellence for Drones & Counter Drone Systems is a scheme under the Department of Science & Technology (DST) aimed at fostering innovation and development in drone technology and counter-drone systems. It supports research, development, and deployment of advanced drone technologies for national security and civilian applications. The scheme focuses on building indigenous capabilities in unmanned aerial systems and anti-drone technologies through collaboration with academic institutions, startups, and industry partners.
objectives: Promote indigenous development of drone and counter-drone technologies
Support research and development in unmanned aerial systems
Enhance national security capabilities through advanced drone technologies
Foster collaboration between academia, startups, and industry
Develop scalable solutions for civilian and defense applications
Strengthen India's self-reliance in critical drone technologies
eligibility: Eligible entities include startups, MSMEs, research institutions, and industry partners engaged in drone technology, counter-drone systems, or related R&D activities. Preference is given to entities with innovative proposals aligned with national security and technological self-reliance goals.
benefits: Benefits include financial support for R&D projects, access to testing and validation facilities, mentorship from domain experts, opportunities for pilot demonstrations, and potential pathways for scaling and commercialization of developed technologies.
financial_support: Financial support is provided in the form of grants or funding for approved R&D projects under the scheme. The exact quantum and mechanism are determined based on project proposals and evaluation by the empowered committee.
application_process: 1. Submit a detailed project proposal through the designated portal. 2. Proposal undergoes technical and financial evaluation by experts. 3. Shortlisted applicants are invited for presentation or discussion. 4. Final selection is made by the empowered committee. 5. Approved projects receive sanction letters and fund disbursement begins as per milestones.
required_documents: Technical details of the proposed solution
caveats: Funding is subject to availability of budget and project viability
Intellectual property rights may be governed by specific terms
Progress is monitored through periodic reviews and milestones
Non-compliance with timelines may lead to withdrawal of support
